runtime_verification: NUXT_AUTH_PASSWORD=8 chars + NUXT_SESSION_PASSWORD=32 chars -> server started (DoD 1)
NUXT_AUTH_PASSWORD=7 chars -> refused to boot: 'NUXT_AUTH_PASSWORD must be set and at least 8 characters long. See .env.example.' (DoD 2)
NUXT_SESSION_PASSWORD=31 chars -> refused to boot: 'NUXT_SESSION_PASSWORD must be set and at least 32 characters long. See .env.example.' (DoD 3)
GET /api/health, no cookie -> 200, body {"status":"ok"}, content-length 15 (DoD 4, AC-3.1/3.2)
POST /api/health -> 404 'Page not found: /api/health', not 200 (DoD 6, AC-3.6 — see deviations)
6 consecutive POST /api/auth/login from one IP -> 401 x5 then 429 with 'Retry-After: 50' (DoD 8, AC-1.11)
deviations: AC-3.6 expected 405 for a non-GET on /api/health; Nitro actually answers 404 'Page not found: /api/health' for a method that matches no registered route. The AC's substance (not 200, no extra method surface) holds. Nitro routing behaviour, not changed. Noted inline in tasks.md.

AC-1.9's example value 'change' (6 chars) is not in fact a placeholder: isPlaceholderSecret does fragment.includes-into-value, and 'change'.includes('change-me') is false. Under the 8 floor no value can be both too short and a placeholder, since the shortest fragment 'change-me' is 9 chars. The gate ordering is therefore pinned at the 32 floor with 'change-me', which is genuinely both. Noted inline in tasks.md.
healthcheckTimeout stays 30 per the Human Gate decision; spec AD-10 and its 'raise to 100' section are marked 未採納, and the tasks.md Task 4 code block was corrected from 100 to 30 to match.

AC-1.7's mixed-whitespace example '   \n\t  ' is 7 characters, so it fails the 8 floor on raw length too and would not prove the trim. Used '   \n\t   ' (8 characters) instead so the case only fails after trimming.
README line 60 (NUXT_SESSION_PASSWORD 'min 32 chars for nuxt-auth-utils') was left as-is per the Task 5 table — it was already correct.
notes_for_qa: Two floors are deliberately different and must stay that way: tests/serverAuthUtils.test.ts has separate describe blocks per floor, and the 31-character session case (AC-1.3) is the anti-regression pin. No existing assertion was loosened to /at least \d+/.
tests/e2e/proxy.e2e.test.ts and tests/loginRoute.test.ts were not modified and both still pass.

Before deploying, confirm on Railway that NUXT_AUTH_PASSWORD (>= 8, random, not a dictionary word) and NUXT_SESSION_PASSWORD (>= 32) are both set and neither is an .env.example placeholder (spec R-6).
